title: Prometheus
description: Prometheus is a time-series database and monitoring system. The Prometheus client for .NET exposes metrics that Prometheus scrapes and stores for alerting and visualization.

data.text: Prometheus is an open-source monitoring system that collects time-series data from instrumented targets. It scrapes metrics from an HTTP endpoint exposed by your application and stores them for querying with PromQL.

data.title: Exposing Metrics
data.content: Add a /metrics endpoint and define custom metrics.

terms.definition: A numerical measurement taken at runtime, such as a counter, gauge, or histogram.
The act of Prometheus pulling metrics from an HTTP endpoint on a schedule.
Prometheus Query Language, used to query time-series data for dashboards and alerts.

data.title: ASP.NET Core Integration
data.text: Use prometheus-net.AspNetCore to automatically collect request metrics and health checks without manual instrumentation.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Prometheus scrapes metrics from an HTTP endpoint
prometheus-net provides counters, gauges, and histograms
Metrics are stored as time-series data
data.takeaway: Prometheus is the de facto standard for metrics collection and alerting in cloud-native .NET apps.

data.title: Exercise: Expose Custom Metrics
data.description: Add Prometheus metrics to a web API and scrape them.
steps: Create an ASP.NET Core Web API project
Add a custom counter for OrdersReceived and a histogram for OrderProcessingDuration
Increment the counter and observe the histogram in an order endpoint
Run Prometheus and configure it to scrape http://localhost:5000/metrics
data.expectedOutcome: Prometheus collects and stores your custom metrics, visible in its expression browser.
